entries.title: read_samples_raw belongs to declared gap "streaming.raw"
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml gap_generation (gaps = baseline minus declared capabilities)
entries.expected: a refusal, because "streaming.raw" is absent from this host's handshake capabilities
entries.actual: refused with error code "unsupported": quackoscope-host-cpp does not serve "read_samples_raw"; capability "streaming.raw" is a declared gap in this session's handshake, which lists the capabilities this host does serve
entries.gap_reason_declared_by_host: read_samples_raw has no handler in quackoscope-host-cpp: contract/contract.yaml declares returns: {type: binary_frame} for it, but envelopes.result carries a JSON result and the 17-byte binary_frame header has no correlation id, so a binary answer cannot be matched to its request id. The two generated clients already disagree about the JSON stand-in -- generated/typescript/contract-client.ts casts a flat result object to BinarySampleFrame, generated/python/contract_types.py expects {header, values} -- and this host will not pick one of them on the contract's behalf.

entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml operations[get_property_value].errors = [not_found, not_connected]; a node reachable after its device was disconnected would mean disconnect_device did nothing
entries.expected: one of [not_found, not_connected]
entries.actual: error not_connected: this session has connected no device; call connect_device first (a device another session connected is not visible here)

entries.title: device_disconnected after a client-initiated disconnect_device
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events.items[device_disconnected] fixes the payload {node_id, reason}, but nothing in the contract says a client-initiated disconnect must push it
entries.expected: no pass/fail is possible: the contract constrains the shape but not the occurrence
entries.actual: the contract constrains the event's shape, never when it must be emitted  observed: no device_disconnected event followed the client's own disconnect_device

entries.title: every event pushed by the host is one of the contract's closed event set
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events.closed = true, items [component_added, component_removed, property_changed, property_descriptor_changed, device_disconnected]
entries.expected: no event name outside the closed set
entries.actual: 8 event(s) received, names seen: component_added, property_changed, component_removed

entries.title: no event carries an id field
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events.carries_id_field = false; "They are not responses and are never correlated."
entries.expected: no event envelope has an id key

entries.title: every event that did arrive carries the payload shape the contract declares for it
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events.items[].payload
entries.expected: 8 conforming event payloads
entries.actual: 8 event(s), every declared payload key present and correctly typed

entries.title: which of the contract's five events this host pushed during the sweep
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events fixes the closed set and each payload shape, but attaches no event to a capability id; gap_generation computes gaps over capabilities only, so a host that pushes no events can neither declare that as a gap nor be failed for it
entries.expected: no pass/fail is possible: the contract constrains the shape but not the occurrence
entries.actual: event occurrence is unconstrained by the contract, so silence is not a verdict  observed: pushed during this sweep: [component_added, property_changed, component_removed]; not pushed: [property_descriptor_changed, device_disconnected]
